items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we sat down and I said well look Ash, look at this, let's go this way. Look, let's do this. ... he wouldn't come around the group after I joined them

ctx.x: So I don't know, I think that they're friends of mine.

When I show them this and I do certain things for them I think that they're friends. I never think that they will take this and use it, and put their name on it. I was very disappointed with Ash, but after --- I liked him so much because Ash, despite that -- let me, you know, get this straight. Ashby is a tremendous -- he's a great guitarist. He's not just a good guitarist. Irvin Ashby is a great-- he's one of the giants. You know, and I admired him so much.

So you know, we sat down and I said well look Ash, look at this, let's go this way. Look, let's do this. And I was very surprised when I heard this record and it was note for note. And I'll tell you the name of the tune is Bop Kick. But as I said, previously, he wouldn't come around the group after I joined them and I wondered why. But later I found out -- I realized that this was why he didn't come. He was kind of embarrassed because of my being there and playing these things, and they realized that he had got…
